source_clause: CR13.1.) The button label will read «Rear».
reasoning: **本節依 R-C42 解封**（64 §1）：其停下之唯一依據為「該配置軸未登記」，而條文自帶適用條件 —— 同 `9.2`。驗證目標：CR13.1 一句定出該捷徑鍵之標籤，其 037 leaf 即本節自身。關鍵情境條件：同 `9.4`（其按鈕即 `9.4` 所定者，跨節取據 R-C29）；依 **R-C34** 三軸暴露 → 補。為什麼這樣切：一葉一 TC。刻意略過：**«Rear» 為 source-quoted token**，照錄不譯（profile §3.4）。

interface_axis_review.axis_9: 暴露 → 全數補 —— 可觀察量在 head unit 之氣候介面（6.3）
interface_axis_review.axis_12: 不暴露 —— 本節不涉 tab 之存在或順序
interface_axis_review.axis_13: 暴露 → 全數補（出處 2.14 C15，跨節取據 R-C29）
interface_axis_review.emea_ics: **排除補並逐條答（R-C36-1）** —— 逐條之答為 `no`：ch16 無對應句（見各條之 `emea_ics_review`）

tcs.tc_title: The rear climate shortcut button is labelled Rear
tcs.test_item: The system shall label the button «Rear»
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-verbatim] The vehicle is one of the vehicles that have additional Rear Climate controls and shortcuts (9.1)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the driver side climate dropdown menu
2. Read the Rear Climate button label
tcs.expected_result:
1. The dropdown menu is displayed
2. The button label reads «Rear»
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

emea_ics_review.ch16_sentence: ch16 十八節**無後排氣候之節**（DR #41 之實測），亦無 status bar dropdown 之後排捷徑，故本條之 EMEA 排除無 ch16 對造句可依
